widgets.default: Load pinol.js as the custom module

widgets.value: JS{return (OSC{/sequence/running,0,false} ? 'WAITS / FOLLOW ACTIVE' : 'WAITING FOR GO') + ' · ' + OSC{/pinol/ui/background,0,false} + ' background'}

JS{var a=Number(OSC{/sequence/cue/current/action,0,false}); return 'Pre '+Number(OSC{/sequence/cue/current/prewait,0,false}).toFixed(1)+' s · Action '+(a<0?'∞':a.toFixed(1)+' s')+' · Post '+Number(OSC{/sequence/cue/current/postwait,0,false}).toFixed(1)+' s';}

JS{var a=Number(OSC{/sequence/cue/next/action,0,false}); return 'Pre '+Number(OSC{/sequence/cue/next/prewait,0,false}).toFixed(1)+' s · Action '+(a<0?'∞':a.toFixed(1)+' s')+' · Post '+Number(OSC{/sequence/cue/next/postwait,0,false}).toFixed(1)+' s';}
STOP WAITS cancels pending cues and follows. It does not stop media or timelines. Double-tap STOP ALL WAITS for every sequence.

Enter the computer running Pinol and its OSCQuery TCP port. Enable OSC / OSCQuery in Pinol Settings. No UDP feedback configuration is required.
A disconnected controller disables show commands. Commands are never queued for replay after reconnecting. Each browser shares the same Pinol connection.
Cue timers use Pinol cue time. Timeline clocks use animation time; ∞ means no finite end. A frozen or paused timeline does not count down in wall-clock seconds.
SHOW follows the selected sequence in Pinol. Sequence selection does not stop background sequences. Library recalls may override values controlled by the sequence.
